resolveExecutableForSolver(String) - Method in class org.smtlib.SMT
Resolves the executable path SMT.startSolver(org.smtlib.SMT.Configuration, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) would use for the given solver name (absent an explicit caller-supplied override -- startSolver's own executable parameter takes precedence there, which this standalone method has no equivalent of), without instantiating an adapter or starting anything -- lets a caller check whether the file actually exists before committing to run tests against it (see the test harness's LogicTests#solversFromEnv, which filters the solver list against this up front so a missing binary is one WARNING line instead of a wall of per-file failures).
